title: प्राथमिक शिक्षामा झाँगड जातिका  बालबालिकाहरूको सहभागिता {Jhangad caste in primary education Children's participation}
nepali: नेपाल एउटा बहुजातीय, बहुभाषिक तथा बहुसांस्कृतिक राष्ट्र हो । यहाँ विभिन्न जातजाति तथा जनजातिहरूको बसोबास रहेको छ । नेपालमा बसोबास गर्ने विभिन्न आदिवासी जनजातिहरूमध्ये नेपालको पूर्वी तराईमा बसोबास गर्ने झाँगडहरू अशिक्षित, गरिब, पिछडिएका र अल्पसङ्ख्यक समुदायका रूपमा चिनिन्छन् । यस समुदायका बालबालिकाहरूको प्राथमिक शिक्षामा  सहभागिता पत्ता लगाउन “प्राथमिक शिक्षामा झाँगड जातिका बालबालिकाहरूको सहभागिता” शीर्षक अन्तर्गत यस अध्ययनलाई अगाडि बढाइएको छ । प्राथमिक शिक्षामा झाँगड जातिका बालबालिकाहरूको सहभागिता पत्ता लगाउने र शैक्षिक उपलब्धिको लेखाजोखा गर्ने उद्देश्य राखी अगाडि बढाइएको यस अध्ययनमा लुडविङ भोन बटनफाइ (सन् १९५०) को प्रणाली सिद्धान्त र अब्राहम मास्लो (सन् १९४३) को उत्प्रेरणा सम्बन्धी सिद्धान्तलाई वैचारिक खाकाको रूपमा राखिएको छ भने सम्बन्धित साहित्यको पुनरवलोकन गर्ने क्रममा विभिन्न लेख, रचना, पुस्तक, शोधपत्र तथा अध्ययन–प्रतिवेदनको समीक्षा गरिएको छ । माथिको उद्देश्य पूरा गर्न वर्णनात्मक तथा विश्लेषणात्मक ढाँचालाई आधार मानी प्राथमिक र द्धितीय स्रोतबाट सङ्कलन गरिएका तथ्याङ्क तथा जानकारीहरूलाई प्रदर्शन, व्याख्या तथा विश्लेषण गर्न तालिका, ग्राफ, स्तम्भचित्र, वृत्तचित्र र प्रतिशतको प्रयोग गरिएको छ । अध्ययन क्षेत्रका झाँगड बालबालिकाहरूको विद्यालय सहभागिता तुलनात्मक रूपमा न्यून रहेको, पछिल्ला वर्षहरूमा भर्नादर बढ्दै गए पनि कक्षा बढ्दै जाँदा भर्नादर घट्दै गएका, सबै झाँगड बालबालिकाहरू विद्यालय जान नसकेको तथ्य प्राप्त भयो । यस जातिका बालबालिकाहरूको शैक्षिक उपलब्धिको लेखाजोखा गर्दा अन्य विद्यार्थीको तुलनामा कक्षा उत्तीर्ण प्रतिशत कम रहेको, शै.व. को बीचैमा कक्षा छाड्ने र कक्षा दोहो¥याउने दर बढी रहेको पाइयो भने सिकाइ उपलब्धि अत्यन्त कमजोर रहेको पाइयो । यसरी हेर्दा मृगौलिया गा.वि.स. मा बसोबास गर्ने झाँगड समुदायका बालबालिकाहरूको विद्यालय सहभागिता र शैक्षिक उपलब्धि कमजोर रहेको छ । विभिन्न शैक्षिक समस्याहरू भोग्न बाध्य यस जातिका बालबालिकाहरूको विद्यालय सहभागिता र शैक्षिक उपलब्धि वृद्धि गर्न आर्थिक अवस्थामा सुधार गर्नुपर्ने, चेतना बढाउनका लागि चेतनामूलक कार्यक्रम सञ्चालन गर्नुपर्ने, छात्रवृत्ति र पर्याप्त शैक्षिक सामग्रीको व्यवस्था गर्नुपर्ने, शैक्षिक नीतिमा परिवर्तन गरी भेदभावलाई अन्त्य गर्नुपर्ने बालश्रमको नियन्त्रण, शिक्षामा सुनिश्चितता र रोजगारीमा आरक्षण दिनुपर्ने साथै सामाजिक जागरण कार्यक्रम मार्फत सामाजिक–साँस्कृतिक संस्कारमा परिवर्तन गर्नुपर्ने देखिन्छ ।
american_english:
Nepal is a multi-caste, multi-lingual and multi-cultural nation.
People of various castes and ethnic groups live here.
Among the indigenous ethnic groups living in Nepal, the Jhangads living in the eastern Terai of Nepal are known as an uneducated, poor, backward and minority community.
To find out the participation of the children of this community in primary education, this study was taken forward under the title "Participation of Jhangad Caste Children in Primary Education."
With the objective of finding out the participation of Jhangad caste children in primary education and assessing their educational achievement, this study was taken forward by placing the system theory of Ludwig von Bertalanffy (1950) and Abraham Maslow's (1943) theory of motivation as the conceptual framework, and while reviewing the related literature, various articles, writings, books, research papers and study reports were reviewed.
To fulfil the above objective, using a descriptive and analytical format as the basis, data and information collected from primary and secondary sources were presented, explained and analyzed using tables, graphs, bar charts, pie charts and percentages.
It was found that the school participation of Jhangad children in the study area is comparatively low, that although the enrollment rate has been increasing in recent years, the enrollment rate decreases as the class increases, and that not all Jhangad children are able to go to school.
When assessing the educational achievement of children of this caste, it was found that the class pass percentage is lower than that of other students, that the rate of dropping out and repeating classes in the middle of the academic year is higher, and that learning achievement is extremely weak.
Looking at this, the school participation and educational achievement of Jhangad community children living in Mrigauliya VDC are weak.
To increase the school participation and educational achievement of the children of this caste, who are forced to face various educational problems, it appears that the economic condition should be improved, awareness-raising programs should be run to increase awareness, scholarships and sufficient educational materials should be arranged, educational policy should be changed to end discrimination, child labor should be controlled, certainty in education and reservation in employment should be given, and through social awakening programs the socio-cultural customs should be changed.

informal_english: Right, so Nepal's a multi-caste, multi-lingual and multi-cultural nation, and all sorts of castes and ethnic groups live there. Among the indigenous ethnic groups, the Jhangads living in the eastern Terai are known as an uneducated, poor, backward and minority community. To find out how the children of this community take part in primary education, this study was carried out under the title 'Participation of Jhangad Caste Children in Primary Education.' The aim was to find out how Jhangad children take part in primary education and to assess their educational achievement, and for that it used Ludwig von Bertalanffy's (1950) system theory and Abraham Maslow's (1943) theory of motivation as the conceptual framework, plus a review of articles, writings, books, research papers and study reports. To meet that aim, using a descriptive and analytical format, the data and information collected from primary and secondary sources were presented, explained and analysed using tables, graphs, bar charts, pie charts and percentages. What they found: school participation of Jhangad children in the study area is comparatively low; although enrolment has been going up in recent years, it drops as the class goes up, and not all Jhangad children can get to school. Their educational achievement is weaker than other students — lower pass rates, more dropping out and repeating mid-year, and very weak learning achievement. So, overall, the school participation and educational achievement of Jhangad community children living in Mrigauliya VDC are weak. To improve things for children of this caste, who face all sorts of educational problems, it looks like the economic condition needs improving, awareness-raising programmes need running, scholarships and enough educational materials need arranging, educational policy needs changing to end discrimination, child labour needs controlling, certainty in education and reservation in employment need giving, and socio-cultural customs need changing through social awakening programmes.
